notes: LANDED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB505). ALL THREE OBLIGATIONS, AT EVERY DIMENSION COUNT. The count sentence had no site (it now shares COBOL1945 with SR20's, the same requirement stated for subscript-2). The ceiling sentence is now per instance against its own dimension. And sentence 3 -- "the table element associated with subscript-2 is the same occurrence or a successive occurrence of the table element associated with the corresponding subscript-1" -- is now the ODOMETER comparison it is: 13.18.63.4 GR12 increments the LEAST inclusive subscript and carries into the next most inclusive one, so a tuple's place in the fill sequence is exactly its LEXICOGRAPHIC rank, and the test is Subscripts.Compare(to, from) >= 0. The scalar `t < from` it replaced was correct only because every tuple longer than one had already been refused; a per-dimension comparison would REJECT LEGAL SOURCE -- MEASURED: `FROM (1 3) TO (2 1)` on a 2x3 table names two SUCCESSIVE elements and now compiles and seeds ([AB]), while `FROM (2 1) TO (1 1)` precedes and draws COBOL1587. The over-rejection control still passes (`FROM (2) TO (2)`, the same occurrence). The lexicographic form also needs no dimension maxima, which matters because a DYNAMIC dimension may have none.
